turns.targetFrench: Un voyageur arrive dans la salle du petit-déjeuner de l'hôtel le matin.
turns.supportEnglish: A traveler arrives at the hotel dining room in the morning.

turns.targetFrench: Il s'adresse à la réceptionniste : « Le petit-déjeuner est-il compris ? »
turns.supportEnglish: He talks to the receptionist: Is breakfast included?

turns.targetFrench: Elle répond : « Oui, il est compris avec votre chambre. »
turns.supportEnglish: She says: Yes, it is included with your room.

turns.targetFrench: Il demande : « Quels sont les horaires du petit-déjeuner ? »

turns.targetFrench: Elle dit que, dans cet hôtel, le service va de 6 h 30 à 10 h.

turns.targetFrench: Le voyageur donne son numéro de chambre : 214.
turns.supportEnglish: The traveler gives his room number: 214.

turns.targetFrench: Puis il demande : « Est-ce un buffet ou un menu ? »
turns.supportEnglish: Then he asks: Is it a buffet or a menu?

turns.targetFrench: Elle explique les consignes de ce buffet : prendre une assiette propre et ne pas emporter de nourriture.
turns.supportEnglish: She explains the buffet rules: take a clean plate and do not take food with you.

turns.targetFrench: Il cherche une table libre et prend un café.
turns.supportEnglish: He looks for a free table and gets coffee.

forms.explanation: Inverted first-person singular of pouvoir (je peux), used to ask 'Can I...?'. Stem change o to eu in the je form. Context: card core:5:word:14.
Inverted third-person singular of être, 'is it?', used in yes/no questions. Context: card core:5:word:11.
Third-person singular present of donner, 'gives'. Irregular in the je form (je donne is regular here, but the nous form is donnons). Context: reader line core:5:line:6.
Third-person singular present of prendre, 'takes; gets (a drink)'. Irregular stem: prend, prenons. Context: reader line core:5:line:9.
Third-person singular present of porter, here 'bears' or 'carries' a number, so 'My room bears the number 214' is rendered as 'My room is 214'. Context: card core:5:word:13.

speaking.scenario: A hotel dining room. You speak to the receptionist about breakfast.
speaking.openingFrench: Bonjour ! Le petit-déjeuner est-il compris ? Quels sont les horaires ? Ma chambre porte le numéro 214.
speaking.openingEnglish: Hello! Is breakfast included? What are the hours? My room is 214.
speaking.instructionEnglish: At a hotel, confirm whether breakfast is included, its hours and where to sit; give your room number.

objectives.englishGoal: Give your room number and ask whether you can sit at any table.
